decisions.quote: In conclusion, data in the Spanish population were consistent with association between ERAP1 and BD as well as with an epistatic interaction between ERAP1 and HLA-B described in the Turkish population, although our results were not statistically significant.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly conclude that their results are consistent with both the ERAP1 association and the epistatic interaction with HLA-B reported by Kirino et al. (2013), despite the lack of statistical significance. Under the codebook, the authors' overall verdict of agreement takes precedence over statistical significance alone.
